main.description: Public lookup of one indexed Certified profile by DID or handle. Handles are resolved through the configured resolver's com.atproto.identity.resolveHandle response; the response DID is validated, but no DID document is fetched for independent verification. Operators trust the resolver configured for their HappyView instance. Authentication is not required.

actor.description: DID or handle of the profile actor.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor is neither a valid DID nor a valid handle, or an unknown parameter was supplied.

errors.name: HandleResolverConfigError
errors.description: HYPERCERTS_HANDLE_RESOLVER_URL is missing or invalid; configure an HTTPS resolver base URL for this HappyView instance.

errors.name: HandleResolutionFailed
errors.description: The configured resolver request failed or returned a response without a valid DID.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: The actor was identified, but no indexed Certified profile exists.

errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed profile could not be queried.

profile.description: The complete indexed Certified profile record with record metadata and its repository DID.
